title: Headroom for Larger and Shared Homes in Personal Services Plan Package Fitting
content:
The apartment a resident holds under an Independent Living Residency Agreement bears on the hours a Personal Services Plan package must provide: larger homes and shared homes are given headroom in the required hours.

## Rule

The required hours add 1.5 hours where the resident's active independent living residency is an Independent Living Cottage Home or an Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe, 1.0 hour where it is any other apartment type held in double occupancy with a second occupant named, and nothing otherwise. The headroom is added before the required hours are rounded to two decimal places half up.

The records read are those of the resident's active independent living residency: its apartment type, its occupancy (single or double) and whether a second occupant is named.

## Ladder

| Active independent living residency | Occupancy | Second occupant named | Headroom |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Cottage Home or Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | Any | Any | 1.5 hours |
| Any other apartment type | Double | Yes | 1.0 hour |
| Any other apartment type | Double | No | None |
| Any other apartment type | Single | — | None |
| No active independent living residency | — | — | None |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Cottage Home held in single occupancy: 1.5 hours.
- An Independent Living One-Bedroom held in double occupancy with the second occupant named: 1.0 hour.
- An Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe held in double occupancy with a second occupant named: 1.5 hours.
